title: Full Formalization of Descartes Rule of Signs using Mathlib Analysis

problemStatement.formal: Formalize Descartes' Rule of Signs: the number of positive real roots of p (counted with multiplicity) is ≤ the number of sign changes in its coefficients, with difference even. Bridge custom signChangesInCoeffs to Mathlib's signVariations API.
problemStatement.plain: Fully formalize Descartes' Rule of Signs in Lean 4 using Mathlib, connecting a custom sign-change counting formulation to Mathlib's polynomial root-sign infrastructure.
whyMatters: Wiedijk's 100 Theorems #100 — a classic result with rich combinatorial and analytic connections
Bridge between custom counting definitions and Mathlib's polynomial.signVariations API
Rolle's theorem applications demonstrate derivative root interlacing

proven: descartes_upper_bound: countPositiveRoots p ≤ signChangesInCoeffs p (uses axiom)
descartes_negative_roots: negative root bound via negSubst
neg_root_map_to_pos: negative roots of p map to positive roots of negSubst p
descartes_upper_bound_via_signVariations: conditional bound via Mathlib (given bridge hypothesis)
rolle_polynomial: Rolle between two roots gives derivative root
n_roots_implies_derivative_roots: n+1 roots give n derivative roots (all proved)
open: Prove signChangesInCoeffs p = p.signVariations to eliminate the main axiom
knownResults.goal: 35 theorems proved, 8 axioms, 0 sorries. Main goal remaining: connect custom signChangesInCoeffs to Mathlib's signVariations to eliminate descartes_upper_bound_axiom.

currentState.focus: DescartesRuleOfSignsOQ01.lean built (445 lines, 0 sorries). Gallery entry created. Upper bound proved from Mathlib, parity result axiomized.
blockers: signChangesInCoeffs is defined via Finset.filter pairs on Fin-indexed coefficients; signVariations uses List-based sign change counting. Equality requires careful coefficient list manipulation.
currentState.nextAction: Prove signChangesInCoeffs p = p.signVariations using Polynomial.coeffs_list or similar. This would unlock descartes_upper_bound_via_signVariations as a fully axiom-free proof.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: DescartesRuleOfSignsOQ01.lean (445 lines, 0 sorries) proves upper bound from Mathlib, negative root framework via negSubst, linear case tight bound. Parity result axiomized. Gallery entry created.
builtItems: countPositiveRoots_eq_roots_countP: countPositiveRoots p = p.roots.countP (0 < ·) for nonzero p — proved via Multiset.countP_eq_card_filter + gt_iff_lt
descartes_upper_bound_via_signVariations: conditional Mathlib bridge using roots_countP_pos_le_signVariations
n_roots_implies_derivative_roots: n+1 distinct roots → n derivative roots, proved using Fin.castSucc_lt_succ + rolle_polynomial
three_roots_two_derivative_roots: a < b < c roots → two derivative roots in (a,b) and (b,c)
nonzero_root_count_le_degree and negative_root_count_le_natDegree: sub-multiset cardinality bounds
zero_sign_changes_no_positive_roots, one_sign_change_at_most_one_root, sign_changes_lt_k_fewer_roots: corollaries via omega
realSign utilities (realSign_pos, realSign_neg, realSign_zero): proved by simp
negSubst_eval, negSubst_negSubst, oppositeSign_comm: helper lemmas proved
signVariations_increase_by_pos_root (PROVED): pos root insertion increases variations
descartes_negative_roots (PROVED, 0 sorries): upper bound on negative roots
descartes_parity AXIOM: parity result (open in Mathlib)
insights: countPositiveRoots p = p.roots.countP (0 < ·): the bridge uses Multiset.countP_eq_card_filter + gt_iff_lt to align custom filter-based counting with Mathlib's countP
descartes_upper_bound_via_signVariations: once bridge hypothesis is proved, full Descartes follows from Mathlib's Polynomial.roots_countP_pos_le_signVariations in one line
KEY REMAINING GAP: signChangesInCoeffs p = p.signVariations — custom definition uses Finset.filter on Fin-indexed coefficients; signVariations uses List-based counting
Polynomial.card_roots_le_degree gives countPositiveRoots ≤ natDegree — combines Multiset.countP_le_card with card_roots_le_degree
Rolle pattern: n_roots_implies_derivative_roots uses StrictMono + Fin.castSucc_lt_succ for the ordering lemma
n_roots_implies_derivative_roots and rolle_polynomial are fully proved (no axioms)
8 axioms remain: descartes_upper_bound_axiom, descartes_parity_axiom, descartes_negative_roots_axiom, derivative_reduces_sign_changes_axiom, plus 4 examples (x2-1, x2+1, x^3-x, alternating)
The main axiom would fall if we could prove signChangesInCoeffs p = p.signVariations
Mathlib has roots_countP_pos_le_signVariations (upper bound) but NOT parity result
negSubst p = p.comp(-X) converts negative roots to positive roots elegantly
signVariations_X_sub_C: for (X-c) with c>0, signVariations = 1 (tight bound)
parity requires: complex conjugate pairs change signVariations by 0 or 2; real positive roots by 1 or 3
descartes_negative_roots proved via negSubst (0 axioms for negative root upper bound)
mathlibGaps: Polynomial.signVariations: defined but the equality signChangesInCoeffs p = p.signVariations needs proof connecting Fin-indexed coefficient function to the List representation
No direct Mathlib lemma connecting custom (filter+card on Fin pairs) to signVariations
Parity result: signVariations ≡ roots.countP (0<.) [MOD 2] — not in Mathlib
Complex root conjugate pairing effect on sign variations — needed for parity proof
nextSteps: Attempt to prove signChangesInCoeffs p = p.signVariations using Polynomial.toList or coefficients enumeration
If equality is too hard, prove countPositiveRoots p ≤ p.signVariations directly (weaker but sufficient for main result)
Submit Aristotle companion file targeting the auxiliary utility lemmas
